summary: Nyxoah SA filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on public offering of 55,232,558 ordinary shares at $1.72 per share, raising ~$95M. The offering includes a 30-day over-allotment option for 8,284,883 additional shares. Certain directors/affiliates indicated interest in buying 13,712,900 shares, but no binding commitment. Underwriters are BofA, Degroof Petercam, and B. Riley. Shares listed on Nasdaq ($1.45 close) and Euronext (€2.46). Settlement T+2 on June 9, 2026. This is a capital-raising event with no change in control, strategic review, or special situation beyond a secondary offering.
